sources.title: Personally executed original fence, variants and raw-evidence computations
Difference-of-differences and probability ordering
sources.details: Reference gap -4-(-3)=-1; policy gap -3-(-3)=0; relative gap 0-(-1)=1. Initial identical policy/reference cancels to zero regardless of each absolute ranking. Natural exp is strictly increasing: equal log scores tie; a negative chosen-minus-rejected score implies chosen probability is lower. Raw sums -13.649187088012695-(-5.2012939453125)=-8.447893142700195; subtract -10.893460392951965 gives 2.44556725025177.
